purpose: Runtime dependency and operational source-import ceilings are zero. Development-only test parity tooling may still use Three until those tests are independently replaced.
rule: package.json runtime dependencies must remain empty. Operational source imports of guarded runtime dependencies must remain zero; development-only test imports may not enter production output.

@react-three/drei.rule: Drei source imports are zero and the package is removed. It may not return.

react.rule: React source imports are zero and the package is removed. It may not return.

react-dom.rule: ReactDOM source imports are zero and the package is removed. It may not return.

three.rule: Operational Three source imports are zero. The live Home Gym PT viewport, scene graph, skinning and WebGL renderer are first-party; Three may exist only in excluded development tests until test parity migration is complete.
